"Night Stalker" '''Raxine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="KOTET" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raxine was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as a World Boss for the Dark vs. Light system. Whenever the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] reaches victory state on a server, Night Stalker Raxine has a chance to spawn at one or more of selected locations on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] alongside other Dark Side World Bosses.<ref name="KOTET" />
